verdict.rationale: dlt supports deployment anywhere Python runs (Airflow, Lambda, containers) and dltHub adds scheduling, backfill, and 'dlthub deploy' for autonomous, logged/auditable pipeline runs, including agent-driven operation via the AI Harness. However, this is largely orchestration/deployment infrastructure rather than a built-in autonomous background-automation feature within dlt itself, and requires external schedulers or the separate dltHub product. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actual autonomous background runs, and detail on failure recovery/alerting for unattended automation.
